name: Mahjong Escape Ancient China Lite
author: byo-pop
description: Replaces a computation of the original with a faster one that can give another result. The look, the rules, the sounds and the pace of play stay as they were. Each change is a toggle, and its help says where play can differ; with the whole mod off the game is the original. docs/LITE_MOD.md has the proof and the measurements.

settings.label: Shuffle without the wait
settings.help: The shuffle button deals the tiles left on the board again. The original searches for a deal that can be cleared for up to a second of the machine's clock, with the game standing still, and deals at random when it finds none. Most boards are solved within a few milliseconds; on some boards no deal exists, and the second is then the whole cost (on the boards after a stretch of the winning moves about one shuffle in eight). With this on the search stops after 200 clock checks of 1,001 steps (about 15 milliseconds), the same on every run, so the random deal it ends with does not depend on the machine's speed. A shuffle that the original would have solved with more steps (none seen in the game) gets a random deal instead, which can leave the board with fewer moves or none. Off: the original's second. A new game's deal keeps its 2 seconds.
